scope: Independent pre-implementation conceptual review of V2-D01 plan and V2-E01 provenance reuse audit, plus parent-proposed diagnostic display.

exposure.note: Only the four assigned local artifacts were read. The reuse audit embeds cohort counts and file inventory, which were visible; no effect estimates were inspected.

checks.log_base_identity: accept: coefficient, SE and covariance transformations are correct; same rows/design are essential.
checks.quartile_model1: accept: raw-scale type-7 cutpoints, preserved ties, Q1 reference and three contrasts are well defined; variance is conditional on estimated cutpoints.
checks.age_boundary: accept: exact count identity is appropriate; outcome/sample-size agreement must not select the boundary.
checks.natural_spline_rank_two: accept: two internal knots yield three ns columns without intercept and a four-dimensional space including intercept. The linear subspace span(1,x) has dimension two; its complement has dimension two under nondegenerate support.
checks.survey_wald: accept: test only the two explicit nonlinear terms with the survey covariance, F=W/2 and declared denominator df=degf(analysis_design). This is an approximate design-based test, not an exact finite-sample guarantee.
checks.multiplicity: accept: four predeclared tests and Bonferroni primary adjustment are suitable; BH remains exploratory under unspecified dependence.
checks.diagnostic_plot: accept: predeclare marker median reference and 5th-95th percentile display range on frozen rows; same spline model, no added test or model selection. Label analyst diagnostic, not original Figure 2 reproduction.

implementation_clarifications: Use B=ns(x,knots=c(q1/3,q2/3),Boundary.knots=range(x),intercept=FALSE), with x=ln(marker). Compute residual B against L=cbind(1,x), then rank-revealing QR retaining exactly two independent columns. Do not blindly take the first two original ns columns or test their coefficients.

Check rank of the complete adjusted model matrix as well as basis rank. A finite but singular nonlinear covariance does not support a two-df Wald test: require an invertible positive-definite tested covariance and otherwise mark non-estimable.
Store the basis transformation and knots. Evaluate new plot x values with the same transformation; do not independently recompute QR on the plotting grid.

For plotting use a full design contrast d(x)=m(x,z)-m(x_ref,z), log OR=d beta and SE=sqrt(d V d'). This correctly includes covariance with the reference; additive noninteracting covariates cancel. At the reference OR=1 and contrast SE=0.

Declare a fixed CI convention before fitting, preferably t quantile with the same design df used in the diagnostic. Call intervals pointwise 95% CIs, not simultaneous bands. Use the same convention in compared log-base fits.

Freeze numeric rank tolerance and CI convention in the implementation specification before outcomes are fitted. These are numerical/reporting clarifications, not requests to revise the substantive plan.

reuse_audit_review.reason: Audit reports separate matching historical source/config/input hashes and zero exit codes for A01-A03, a current R/survey probe, and explicit provenance limitations.
limits: This reviewer evaluated the supplied audit, not the underlying execution logs or files independently.
Current output hashes are an inventory, not proof outputs were unchanged since execution.
Current environment probe is not full historical binary/package equivalence.
Hashes and successful exits do not validate FI definition, pooling weights, survey domain handling, model inference, or original-paper methods.
Source-method confirmation and unresolved design-definition gates remain active even though implementation of this bounded plan is approved.

age_source_gate: Parent reports source wording conflict: 50 and older / younger than 50 excluded / over 50. This satisfies the plan ambiguity branch when documented as externally supplied source verification: retain existing >=50 operational predicate and audit both boundary counts; no boundary model reruns. Exact author code predicate remains unverified. This reviewer did not independently read the article.
